Lessons: What Prayer Is — and Is Not; Praying Like Jesus Taught; Listening and Stillness; Praying Through Hard Seasons; Fasting, Journaling and Scripture; Growing Steady Roots
Description: If prayer feels hard, rushed or one-sided, you are not alone — and you are very welcome here. This gentle, practical course helps you build a real prayer life at your own pace, rooted in Scripture and honest conversation with God. Small steps, lasting growth.
KeyTopics: Prayer; Faith; Anxiety; Fear; Hope; Discipleship
